description: Lets the agent see the full desktop and operate the mouse and keyboard through native Windows UI control. Non-Windows input backends are a later phase.
skill_summary: How to observe and operate the host desktop with screenshot, pointer, literal text, and key/chord tools using the mandatory screenshot→inspect→one action→verify loop. Load when a task requires seeing or operating a native desktop UI.
migration_note: Excluded from this Administrator coding port at the user’s explicit request; remains unavailable.
